from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one document in the collection, capturing its identity and what it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
